lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular maxima are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns along the mid-lateral and posterior flank, forming a dense grid of luminance nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to create an orthogonal grid-like pattern across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features run horizontally along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance values on the upper ridge and shadow-depth values on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Isolated, low-density high-luminance blobs are visible within the posterior silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Several distinct, elongated organisms (Echeneidae) are visible trailing and attached to the pelvic and pectoral regions.
